output.subject: We have received your complaint about your visit to our Lantern Hill branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us. We have received your complaint and have read it carefully.

You told us that on 3 September you visited our Lantern Hill branch to deposit a check and to ask about a savings account for your daughter. You told us the teller laughed at your accent in front of other people and said to you, "this is America, speak English." You said you felt humiliated. You also mentioned that you have banked with us for eight years and had never been treated this way before. You asked us to explain what we are going to do.

We are truly sorry for how upset and hurt this experience has left you, and we are grateful that you took the time to tell us about it.

Your complaint is now being reviewed by a specialist team, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The customer wrote in Spanish, and her complaint is about being mocked for her English.
This draft is in English so every word can be checked before signing; a Spanish-reading colleague or approved translation should produce and verify any Spanish version.
If a Spanish version is sent, it must keep: her account framed as hers ('Usted nos indicó que…'), no-fault sympathy, an unnamed specialist team, and 'dentro de 10 días hábiles'.
No Spanish version may add commitments on outcomes, disciplinary action or investigation steps.
The customer describes the incident as accent/language-based discrimination; the reply takes no position on this.
The customer asks what the bank will do; the specialist team must decide what can be shared.
Confirm the Lantern Hill branch and the 3 September visit date before sending.
The customer's savings account question for her daughter was not answered; decide whether to follow up on it.
The customer gave a phone number; consider whether a call, possibly in Spanish, is appropriate in addition to the written reply.
The customer says she has been with the bank for eight years; verify if relevant to the response.
